---
name: Factual correction
about: Suggest a correction to a public academic fact or broken publication link
title: "[Correction] "
---

### Current page and statement

Link to the page and quote only the public fact that needs correction.

### Proposed correction

State the accurate title, author, venue, status, date, identifier, or link.

### Public source

Provide an authoritative DOI, publisher, repository, institutional, or other verifiable source. Do not include private records or unpublished material.
